newsitem.title: USA: U S West launches calling card.
newsitem.headline: U S West launches calling card.

text.p: U S West on Monday introduced the U S WEST Express Calling Card, which allows users to place domestic long distance calls anytime from anywhere in the United States for $0.20 a minute.
All existing U S WEST Calling Card customers with active accounts in the 10 states where it has regulatory approval to issue the new Express Calling Card will get one of the cards this week.
The cards are available in Arizona, Colorado, Idaho, Minnesota, Nebraska, North Dakota, Oregon, Utah, Washington and Wyoming.
